title: Norwood Hospital moves closer to being acquired through eminent domain
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Massachusetts Senate approved a bill allowing eminent domain seizure of Norwood Hospital for transfer to a nonprofit owner.
Norwood Hospital has been closed since June 2020 after flooding; construction halted when Steward Health Care filed for bankruptcy.
The bill enables the state to seize the property from Medical Properties Trust and transfer it to a qualified nonprofit entity.

title: Patriots rookie Eli Raridon is looking like a potential Day 1 contributor
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Patriots' rookie Eli Raridon excels in training camp, stepping up as potential backup tight end after Julian Hill's injury.
Eli Raridon, a 2026 third-round pick, stands out in team drills with athleticism and ties with Hunter Henry in the depth chart.
Head coach Mike Vrabel praises Raridon's speed and adaptability, signaling a promising start despite initial rookie challenges.

title: Were they dishonest with me at the quick lube shop?
author: John Paul
bullets: Quick lube shop recommended unnecessary air filter changes due to lack of service history, not actual inspection.
Mercedes brake fluid changes are recommended every three years to prevent moisture-related issues, regardless of mileage.
Subaru Forester's intermittent rear hatch opening may be caused by remote, latch, or electrical issues, requiring further diagnosis.

title: Abington police officer placed on leave after chase of stolen car ends in crash that killed 17-year-old boy
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Abington officer placed on leave after SUV chase ends in fatal crash, killing 17-year-old Sebastian Hamilton.
The stolen 2019 Hyundai crashed into a tree, injuring four teenage passengers, all hospitalized with critical injuries.
Officer on leave is being supported; leave is standard procedure after fatal crash under investigation, not punitive.

title: Madden 27 Ratings: Christian Gonzalez is NFL’s top-ranked CB in new game
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Christian Gonzalez of the New England Patriots is rated 98, the highest among cornerbacks in Madden 27.
The Madden 27 game releases August 13, with early access available starting August 6.
Six players achieved a 99 overall rating, including Ja'Marr Chase and Josh Allen, while Gonzalez is among five at 98.

title: Jeff Passan floats blockbuster trade for Red Sox and Marlins
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Jeff Passan suggests Red Sox trade for Marlins' shortstop Otto Lopez and catcher Liam Hicks before MLB trade deadline.
Lopez, a potential leadoff hitter, has hit .329 with 27 doubles, nine home runs, and 22 steals this season.
Hicks could add power to the lineup, batting .279 with 14 home runs and 60 RBIs for Miami this year.

title: Death of woman, 18, found dead in Mattapan home owned by Pressley’s husband ruled a homicide
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: An 18-year-old woman, Yoseliani Marte, was found dead from a gunshot wound in a Mattapan home on July 18.
The death occurred in a house owned by Conan Harris, husband of Congresswoman Ayanna Pressley; authorities have ruled it a homicide.
The Boston Police Department continues to investigate; no arrests or charges have been made as of Thursday.

title: Caleb Lomu is learning more than just right tackle at his first training camp
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Caleb Lomu is gaining experience at multiple offensive line positions in Patriots training camp, primarily playing right tackle.
Coach Mike Vrabel praises Lomu's versatility, noting he has also practiced as a guard and jumbo tight end.
The Patriots intend to explore Lomu's potential across different positions, enhancing his adaptability for team roles.

title: Kayshon Boutte addresses trade rumors, future with Patriots
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Kayshon Boutte remains focused on playing for the Patriots despite ongoing trade rumors this offseason.
Patriots coach Mike Vrabel stated the team might trade a receiver to manage their crowded wide receiver roster.
Boutte continues to perform well in training camp, establishing a strong connection with quarterback Drake Maye.

title: Man charged after allegedly shoving 69-year-old woman at Nantucket ICE protest
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: Lee M. Kennedy, 62, charged with assault and disorderly conduct after allegedly pushing a woman at a Nantucket protest.
The incident occurred during an Indivisible Nantucket vigil related to recent ICE activity, on South Beach Street.
Kennedy admitted to pushing the woman; arraignment set for September 8, no lawyer listed yet.
